evaluation_details.summary: The codebase thoroughly meets all architectural and functional requirements defined in SPECIFICATIONS.md. It explicitly uses Google ADK's ParallelAgent, LoopAgent, and SequentialAgent, integrates Gemini Skills, maintains the centralized global state schema, and gracefully handles budgetary constraints and impossible inputs.

criteria.title: FlightResearcher
criteria.description: [1. Parallel Agent (Discovery Team)] **FlightResearcher:** Locates transport, travel times, and costs.
criteria.feedback: The FlightResearcher agent is properly configured to research transport options, flight durations, and estimated costs.
criteria.evidence: create_flight_researcher() in pipeline/agents.py defines the FlightResearcher agent with save_flight_research tool.

criteria.title: HotelResearcher
criteria.description: [1. Parallel Agent (Discovery Team)] **HotelResearcher:** Finds lodging matching interests and neighborhood safety.
criteria.feedback: The HotelResearcher agent discovers lodging options across tiers while factoring in neighborhood safety and user interests.
criteria.evidence: create_hotel_researcher() in pipeline/agents.py defines the HotelResearcher agent with save_hotel_research tool.

criteria.title: ActivityPlanner
criteria.description: [1. Parallel Agent (Discovery Team)] **ActivityPlanner:** Compiles landmarks, restaurants, and tours.
criteria.feedback: The ActivityPlanner agent fetches multi-day landmarks, dining, and activities using Gemini skills and web search.
criteria.evidence: create_activity_planner() in pipeline/agents.py loads the activity planner skill toolset and tools.

criteria.title: Scheduler
criteria.description: [2. Loop Agent (Optimization Room)] **Scheduler:** Reads research, builds the day-by-day sequence, and calculates total costs.
criteria.feedback: The Scheduler agent synthesizes raw research into a day-by-day sequence and calculates total itinerary costs.
criteria.evidence: create_scheduler() in pipeline/agents.py and save_itinerary_schedule() in pipeline/tools.py build schedules and compute costs.

criteria.title: BudgetEnforcer
criteria.description: [2. Loop Agent (Optimization Room)] **BudgetEnforcer:** Validates the itinerary against the user's budget.
criteria.feedback: The BudgetEnforcer agent validates total estimated costs against the user's budget boundary.
criteria.evidence: create_budget_enforcer() in pipeline/agents.py and evaluate_budget_and_finalize() in pipeline/tools.py validate budget limits.

criteria.title: Success
criteria.description: [Loop Constraints] **Success:** If cost ≤ budget, `budget_approved` is set to `true` and the loop terminates.
criteria.feedback: When estimated costs are within the budget, budget_approved is set to true and the refinement loop completes successfully.
criteria.evidence: evaluate_budget_and_finalize() in pipeline/tools.py sets budget_approved=True when cost <= budget.

criteria.title: Failure
criteria.description: [Loop Constraints] **Failure:** If cost > budget, the agent provides `critic_feedback` (e.g., "Replace 5-star hotel with 3-star"), sets `budget_approved` to `false`, and triggers the Scheduler for the next iteration.
criteria.feedback: When costs exceed budget, budget_approved is set to false and actionable critic_feedback is provided for the next loop iteration.
criteria.evidence: evaluate_budget_and_finalize() generates specific critic_feedback and sets budget_approved=False when cost > budget.

criteria.title: Cap
criteria.description: [Loop Constraints] **Cap:** Maximum of 5 iterations.
criteria.feedback: The optimization loop is capped at a maximum of 5 refinement iterations.
criteria.evidence: LoopAgent in pipeline/agents.py and pipeline/runner.py enforce max_iterations=5.

criteria.title: Structural Integrity (30%)
criteria.description: [Student Assignment Milestones] **Structural Integrity (30%)**: Must explicitly declare ParallelAgent and LoopAgent frameworks.
criteria.feedback: The pipeline explicitly declares and orchestrates ParallelAgent for discovery and LoopAgent for optimization.
criteria.evidence: pipeline/agents.py imports and constructs ParallelAgent(subagents=[FlightResearcher, HotelResearcher, ActivityPlanner]) and LoopAgent(subagents=[Scheduler, BudgetEnforcer]).

criteria.title: Context Extraction & State Management (40%)
criteria.description: [Student Assignment Milestones] **Context Extraction & State Management (40%)**: The Scheduler must read critic_feedback from prior iterations to modify the trip successfully.
criteria.feedback: State schema is strictly maintained and the Scheduler reads critic_feedback from preceding iterations to adaptively adjust itinerary choices.
criteria.evidence: create_scheduler() system instructions explicitly require reading session_state['critic_feedback'], and pipeline/state.py manages the centralized schema.

criteria.title: Graceful Failure Handling (30%)
criteria.description: [Student Assignment Milestones] **Graceful Failure Handling (30%)**: Must handle impossible inputs (e.g., extremely low budgets) without crashing.
criteria.feedback: Impossible inputs and extreme budget constraints are handled gracefully without application crashes.
criteria.evidence: Input validation in app.py and loop exhaustion fallback handling in pipeline/runner.py ensure stable execution and structured responses.

strengths: Clean architecture utilizing Google ADK ParallelAgent and LoopAgent with proper state management and skill toolset integration.
Comprehensive validation and error handling for edge cases, impossible budgets, and malformed inputs.
Full state schema compliance with dynamic feedback-driven loop refinement up to the 5-iteration cap.
